claims: The Artemis II mission is estimated to cost over $4 billion for a single launch.
The Artemis II mission cost covers the Space Launch System (SLS) rocket and Orion capsule.
The Artemis II mission is part of the NASA Artemis program.
The NASA Artemis program is projected to cost roughly $93 billion through 2025.
NASA Office of Inspector General (OIG) estimates the total launch cost for Artemis II at approximately $4.1 to $4.2 billion per mission.
The Orion capsule for the first two flights is projected to cost $9.3 billion.
The overall multi-year Artemis program is estimated to cost $93 billion through 2025.
The cost of Artemis II includes the SLS rocket, Orion crew capsule, and ground support systems
